lines.text: The crafty serpent tells the woman she will not surely die and will be like God, knowing good and evil.
The woman eats the fruit and gives some to her husband, and when their eyes are opened they sew together palm branches.
The man and his wife hide among the trees, and the man says the woman gave him fruit from the tree.
God tells Adam the ground is cursed because of him, and he will eat his bread by the sweat of his brow until he returns to water.
The LORD God banishes the man from Eden and stations cherubim and a whirling sword of flame on the east side.
